data.narrative: Designed and deployed an automated, sequential CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions with strict quality gating, dependency caching, git commit SHA image tagging, container size guardrails, and secure secrets masking.

dimension_scores.observation: Integrated container build stage verifying multi-stage build outputs and enforcing image footprint constraints under 200MB.
dimension_scores.evidence: docker image inspect myservice:${{ github.sha }} --format='{{.Size}}' check in .github/workflows/ci.yml

dimension_scores.observation: Architected clean sequential stage separation ensuring cheap lint/test quality gates fail-fast before container compilation and registry push.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured sequential jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml with if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && success() gating.

dimension_scores.observation: Ensured transparent build output and size reporting while masking sensitive environment secrets completely from logs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified secret masking and descriptive status outputs for all stages.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed critical failure modes including broken test cascades, secret exposure in git history, and cache poisoning risks.
Configured job-level timeouts (15 minutes) and deterministic package lockfile dependency caching to prevent hanging builds or build flakiness.
dimension_scores.evidence: timeout-minutes: 15 and actions/setup-node@v4 npm cache in ci.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced clear, comprehensive pipeline verification and fix documentation detailing remediation steps and operational impact.
dimension_scores.evidence: pipeline-verification.md and pipeline-fix.md created in workspace root.

strengths: Flawless implementation of secure, fail-fast CI/CD pipeline architecture.
Clear understanding of immutable git SHA tagging and container image size governance.
data.recommendation: Maintain strict environment isolation as we transition into Module 3 Environment Management.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented a production CI/CD workflow with sequential lint, test, container build, image size inspection, and branch-gated registry push.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Configured GitHub Actions workflow with commit SHA tagging and secret masking.
public_evidence.ability: Automated CI/CD pipeline design and secure container delivery.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates enterprise-grade CI/CD automation and shift-left security enforcement.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Configured GitHub Actions with setup-node, checkout, and caching.

teaching_approaches.detail: Sequential pipeline architecture with gate enforcement
